title: bug: report_blocked picks the architect to page by team.role only, but the launchers put every architect on the role-less project team, so every block escalates to the governors as "no live architect" and #architects has never received a block page
description:
Filed by defect hunt #16 (task-151a2c54, architect-2a219562) on 2026-11-04. Found by the lane-2 subagent; the holder re-ran the repro and re-read every cited line at b9205914.

PROBLEM
- packages/moe-daemon/src/util/workerLiveness.ts:69-78, findFreshestLiveWorkerByRole:
  - it collects only teams whose `role === 'architect'`;
  - it returns null when there are none (:73);
  - it counts a worker only when `worker.teamId` is one of those teams (:78).
  It has no id-prefix fallback.
- Its only caller is tools/reportBlocked.ts:405-417. A null result makes the mention prefix `@governors ` (:417), so the 🚧 page skips #architects and is addressed to the governors.
- The launchers deliberately give a team role to governors only: scripts/moe-agent.sh:2105-2114 and :2516-2520, and moe-agent.ps1:1783-1788 and :1970-1975. Their comment: "For architect/worker/qa we omit role ... The mention router falls back to a workerId-substring match ... when team.role isn't set."
- util/workerRole.ts:22-52 (resolveWorkerRole) calls a seat on a role-less team "not a rare edge". It resolves the team role first, then the id prefix (roleFromWorkerId). This selector is the one role lookup that skips that fallback.
- Contract: docs/MCP_SERVER.md, `### moe.report_blocked`, the Ping routing bullets (:1241-1242). The daemon direct-mentions the freshest live architect, "resolving the role through `worker.teamId`", and escalates to the governors only "with no live architect".
- Live state, read-only at 05:55Z: the "moes" team (team-a94dc136, role null) holds all 4 architects, 3 QA and 4 workers. The "Architects" team (team-ceeda973, role architect) has 0 members.

EVIDENCE
- Repro: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-151a2c54/B/zzHuntB_reportBlockedRolelessArchitect.test.ts, with its .output.txt beside it. In a git archive of b9205914, run `cd packages/moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/tools/zzHuntB_reportBlockedRolelessArchitect.test.ts`. It fails: it expects "architects: (mention of the architect) 🚧 worker-… blocked on task-1: …" and receives only "governors: (governors mention) 🚧 …". Its first assertion, that resolveWorkerRole gives 'architect' for the same seat, passes.
- Production (#governors, .moe/messages/chan-15c8e232.jsonl, counted by the holder): 148 system 🚧 block lines, 139 addressed to the governors group and 0 to an architect. #architects (chan-18116c9a.jsonl) has received none. Example: 2026-11-04T05:25:21.251Z "🚧 qa-58a8e460 blocked on task-87cba58c…" went to the governors 40 s after architect-2a219562's last activity (activity.log 05:24:40.817Z).

FIX DIRECTION
In findFreshestLiveWorkerByRole, match a worker when its team's role equals the role. When its team has no role, or it has no team or a missing team, match it when roleFromWorkerId(worker.id) equals the role. That is resolveWorkerRole's precedence: an explicit roled team still wins over the id. Keep the liveness window, the excluded ids and the tie-break as they are. Then sync the Ping routing wording in `### moe.report_blocked`.
- Hunk ownership in docs/MCP_SERVER.md: edit only the Ping routing bullets (:1241-1242). The Stale-block visibility bullet (:1237) belongs to the sibling stale-block row filed in the same hunt.

FILES
- packages/moe-daemon/src/util/workerLiveness.ts
- packages/moe-daemon/src/util/workerLiveness.test.ts
- packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/reportBlocked.test.ts
- docs/MCP_SERVER.md (### moe.report_blocked, Ping routing only)
Nothing here is held by an open row at 06:01Z.
definitionOfDone: A report_blocked on a task whose only live architect sits on a role-less team, with an architect- id prefix, direct-mentions that architect in #general and #architects, while #governors gets its unmentioned copy. This is proven by a new vitest case asserting the hunt repro's expectations.

New vitest cases in workerLiveness.test.ts pin the rest. A live seat on a roled team whose role is not architect is never picked, even with an architect- prefix. With no live architect, the ping still escalates to the governors. The existing workerLiveness and reportBlocked tests pass unchanged.
docs/MCP_SERVER.md's `### moe.report_blocked` Ping routing text states the team-role-then-id-prefix rule, and no other section of the file changes.

implementationPlan.description:
Fix the selector and pin it in workerLiveness.test.ts. Edit with the Edit tool only (global rail: TOOL witness). Read mem:gotcha-daemon-team-membership-and-freshness first. The architect's verified dry run is /mnt/d/moe-scratch/plan-31a2aa2f/prototype.diff (+98/-6 over the 4 files, gate green). Mirror it.

A. packages/moe-daemon/src/util/workerLiveness.ts, findFreshestLiveWorkerByRole only:
- Add `import { roleFromWorkerId } from './workerRole.js';` under the type import. workerRole.ts imports StateManager as a type only, so there is no runtime cycle. teamMembershipHeal.ts:3 already imports it this way.
- Replace three things with a `teamsById` Map (skip a team entry with no id): the roleTeamIds Set, its `if (roleTeamIds.size === 0) return null;` early return, and the `roleTeamIds.has(worker.teamId)` filter.
- Per worker:
  - skip it when it has no teamId;
  - skip it when its team is not in the map;
  - compute `const seatRole = team.role || (typeof worker.id === 'string' ? roleFromWorkerId(worker.id) : null);`;
  - skip it unless `seatRole === role`.
  That is resolveWorkerRole's precedence (util/workerRole.ts:48-53). A roled team wins over the id. A team with no role (null, or no role key in a legacy team file) defers to the id prefix.
- Keep everything after that as it is: excludeWorkerIds, isWorkerAlive with nowMs/timeoutMs, and the lowest-id tie-break.
- Do NOT fall back for a worker with no team or a missing team. Two existing cases pin that skip: 'skips workers with no teamId or a teamId pointing at a missing team' (:114-117) and 'returns null when no team carries the requested role' (:119-127). DoD 2 keeps every existing test unchanged; see executionContract.compatibility. Leave both cases byte-for-byte.
- Update the JSDoc paragraph that starts 'Role membership resolves through `worker.teamId`' to say three things:
  - the rule is team role first, then the id prefix;
  - the launchers' role-less project team is the common case;
  - a worker with no team, or whose team is not in `teams`, is still skipped.
- Error handling: the function stays total. A non-string worker id must not throw, because report_blocked calls this outside its best-effort chat try/catch. Guard it with the typeof check and a one-line comment saying why. No new I/O.

B. packages/moe-daemon/src/util/workerLiveness.test.ts: append ONE new top-level describe at EOF, 'findFreshestLiveWorkerByRole: team role first, then the id prefix'. It holds exactly 6 plain `it` cases (no it.each; the gate counts 21 tests in the file). Reuse the file's team/worker/architect helpers, TEAMS and NOW_MS. Add `const PROJECT = team('team-project', null)`, `const MIXED: Team[] = [...TEAMS, PROJECT]` and a local findIn(teams, workers, opts) helper.
1. Role-less team, id prefix. An architect- seat on a role-less team matches by its id prefix when teams = [PROJECT] only, which proves the early return is gone. A legacy team object with its role key deleted matches too.
2. Roled non-architect team. A live seat on team-workers is never picked, even when named 'architect-misfiled' and fresher. With an older role-less-team architect beside it, the older one is picked.
3. An explicit architect team wins over an id that declares another role: worker('worker-promoted') on team-architects is picked.
4. Role-less-team seats whose id declares another role or none are never picked: 'worker-x', 'qa-x', 'governor-x', 'seat-x' and 'human'. A record with a non-string id (`42 as unknown as string`) does not throw, and the result is null.
5. No live architect gives null, which is what makes report_blocked escalate to the governors. Cover three role-less-team architects: one stale (LIVENESS_TIMEOUT_MS / 1000 + 1 s), one DEAD, and one excluded via excludeWorkerIds.
6. Roled-team and role-less-team architects are pooled. The fresher one wins whichever team it is on, and a lastActivityAt tie breaks to the lowest id in both iteration orders.
Cases 1, 2 and 6 fail on the unfixed selector (RED check done in the dry run). Cases 3-5 pin invariants and pass either way.
implementationPlan.note: findFreshestLiveWorkerByRole now resolves team role first, then roleFromWorkerId for a team that exists with no role; no-team/missing-team still skipped (existing cases untouched). Added 6-case describe at EOF of workerLiveness.test.ts. Verification runs at step 4.

Added resolveWorkerRole import and a nested describe with 2 cases (hunt repro end to end; stale/DEAD escalation) before 'always posts to #governors'. No existing case or helper edited; reportBlocked.ts untouched.
Ping routing bullet of ### moe.report_blocked now states 'team role first, then the id prefix'. git diff shows one hunk, one changed line.
Plan verification command ran fresh in a git-archive snapshot: docs grep 1, tsc + test-file tsc clean, workerLiveness 21, workerRole 6, reportBlocked 65, 3 files / 92 tests passed, PINNED, exit 0.

implementationPlan.description:
Adversarial self-review, once, at the end. Load the adversarial-self-review skill and read your own diff as an attacker:
1. report_blocked must never throw from the selector. Try a non-string id, a null worker or team entry, a team without an id, and a team whose role key is missing.
2. Precedence: a roled team always wins. An architect- seat on the worker, qa or governor team is never paged, and a worker- id on the architect team still is.
3. The pre-existing cases are byte-identical: 15 in workerLiveness and 63 in reportBlocked. `git diff` shows only additions in both test files, plus the one import line.
4. excludeWorkerIds, the 120 s window and the lowest-id tie-break behave exactly as before. The blocked worker and the caller can still never be paged.
5. The doc diff is one line, inside the Ping routing bullet.
6. What breaks if this runs twice concurrently? Nothing: the selector is pure, with no writes.
If the review changes any byte, re-run step 4's command and submit that fresh output with moe.complete_task.
implementationPlan.note: Self-review, no bytes changed: (1) selector stays total — null worker/team guarded by ?., team without id skipped, typeof guard on worker.id, missing role key falls to prefix (pinned by tests); (2) truthy team.role always wins, roled non-architect team never paged, worker- id on architect team still paged; (3) git diff shows zero removed lines in both test files, only additions plus the one import; (4) excludeWorkerIds, isWorkerAlive window, lowest-id tie-break lines untouched; (5) docs diff is one hunk, one line; (6) selector is pure, no writes, so concurrency is moot. Known leftover (ruled in plan): a seat with no team or a missing team is still not paged — no production impact, all live seats sit on the role-less moes team.

comments.content: Planning ruling (architect-c33f294e, 2026-11-04). The FIX DIRECTION also asks for the id-prefix fallback when a worker has no team or its team is missing, which is full resolveWorkerRole parity. That conflicts with DoD 2, which says the existing tests pass unchanged. Measured on a snapshot of 3500ae19, full parity fails exactly 2 existing cases in workerLiveness.test.ts: 'skips workers with no teamId or a teamId pointing at a missing team' and 'returns null when no team carries the requested role'. The DoD is human-owned, so the plan applies the fallback only to a seat whose team exists and has no role. That is the launcher shape DoD 1 names, and both cases stay byte-identical. A seat with no team, or whose team is missing, stays unpaged as it is today. That leftover gap has no production impact right now: every live architect, worker and QA seat sits on the role-less moes team (team-a94dc136). Full parity would be a separate row that rewrites those 2 cases on purpose. Also, the hunt repro's slice(0, 60) literals are mis-sized: 🚧 is two UTF-16 code units. They fail even with the fix, whose routing is correct, so the new case asserts anchored strings instead. Verified dry run: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/plan-31a2aa2f/prototype.diff (+98/-6, all gates green, 4 new cases fail without the fix).

executionContract.intendedBehavior: moe.report_blocked direct-mentions the freshest live architect on the launchers' role-less project team, whose role comes from its architect- id prefix. The mention goes to #general and #architects, and #governors gets an unmentioned copy. findFreshestLiveWorkerByRole resolves a seat's role from its team's role first. When the seat's team exists but has no role, it uses the id prefix. It returns null, which escalates to @governors, only when no live, non-excluded architect resolves.
acceptanceCriteria: Only a live architect-2a219562 exists, on a role-less 'moes' team. report_blocked then returns notified {target:'architect-2a219562', via:'freshest-live-architect'}. #general and #architects get '@architect-2a219562 🚧 worker-1 blocked on task-1: …', and #governors gets the same text unmentioned.
An architect- seat on a roled non-architect team is never returned. A non-architect id on the architect team still is.
When the role-less team's architect is stale, DEAD or excluded, the selector returns null. report_blocked then answers governors-fallback, and the @governors copy goes to #governors only.
The 15 existing workerLiveness cases and 63 existing reportBlocked cases are unchanged and pass.
docs/MCP_SERVER.md changes in exactly one line: the Ping routing bullet of ### moe.report_blocked, which then states 'team role first, then the id prefix'.
invariants: A team with a role always decides the seat's role. The id prefix is consulted only when the seat's team has none.
The selector never throws, whether on non-string ids or null entries: report_blocked must not fail on chat routing.
The liveness window (isWorkerAlive, 120 s), excludeWorkerIds and the lowest-id tie-break are unchanged.
The blocked worker and the caller are still excluded, so an architect never pages itself.
compatibility: Ruling on the DoD versus the fix direction. The description's fix direction also wants the id-prefix fallback for a worker with no team or a missing team, which is full resolveWorkerRole parity. Measured on a 3500ae19 snapshot, that fails exactly 2 existing cases in workerLiveness.test.ts: 'skips workers with no teamId or a teamId pointing at a missing team' and 'returns null when no team carries the requested role'. DoD 2 keeps the existing tests unchanged, and the DoD is human-owned. So the fallback applies only to a seat whose team exists and has no role. Both cases stay byte-identical and keep passing. The leftover gap has no production impact today: every live architect, worker and QA seat sits on the role-less 'moes' team (team-a94dc136). Full parity would be a separate row that rewrites those 2 cases on purpose. The ruling is recorded as a task comment too.
Wire shapes are unchanged: the notified target/via values, the message strings, and the channel set and order.
Legacy .moe/teams files that lack a role key behave as role-less teams. The check is truthiness, as in resolveWorkerRole.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: (a) Full resolveWorkerRole parity, the description's fix direction: also fall back to the id prefix for no team or a missing team. Rejected: it fails 2 existing workerLiveness cases (measured), against DoD 2's 'existing tests pass unchanged'. (b) Chosen: fall back to the id prefix only when the seat's team exists and has no role. It fixes the production bug fully and keeps every existing test. (c) Call resolveWorkerRole directly. Rejected: it needs a StateManager, and this helper is pure over iterables by design. (d) Give architects a roled team in the launchers. Out of scope: the launchers set a role only for governors on purpose (moe-agent.sh:2105-2114), and the mention router relies on that.

completionSummary: findFreshestLiveWorkerByRole (util/workerLiveness.ts) now resolves a seat's role team-role-first, then by id prefix via roleFromWorkerId, but only when the seat's team exists and has no role (resolveWorkerRole's precedence). So report_blocked direct-mentions the freshest live architect on the launchers' role-less project team (#general + #architects, unmentioned copy to #governors) instead of always escalating to @governors. A roled non-architect team still never matches, a no-team/missing-team seat is still skipped (the 2 existing cases stay byte-identical, per the DoD-vs-fix-direction ruling in the task comment), and the selector stays total on null entries/non-string ids. Liveness window, excludeWorkerIds and lowest-id tie-break are unchanged; reportBlocked.ts is untouched. Tests: 6 new cases in workerLiveness.test.ts (21 total) and a nested describe with 2 cases in reportBlocked.test.ts (65 total) covering the hunt repro end to end plus stale/DEAD escalation; zero existing lines changed. docs/MCP_SERVER.md: one line, the Ping routing bullet of moe.report_blocked, now states 'team role first, then the id prefix'.
